content: Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero Eliɑsibu u seewɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be bɑ tie, bɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Yɑ̃ɑnun ɡɑni seeyɑ. Mɑ bɑ yi sɑ̃rɑsiɑ bɑ yi nɛnɛm kɑ yɑ̃ku yɑ̃ki. Yen biruwɑ bɑ yen ɡɑmbobɑ doke. Sɑɑ min di, bɑ mɑɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑru sɔnwɑ Mɛɑn kɔ̃su yerun di sere n kɑ ɡirɑri kɔ̃su yee te bɑ mɔ̀ Hɑnɑnɛɛliɔ. Mɑ bɑ mɑɑ ten tii sɑ̃rɑsiɑ.
Yerɑ Yerikoɡibu kɑ Sɑkuri Imirin bii bɑ sɔmburu kuɑ Eliɑsibun bɔkuɔ.
Senɑɑɡibu bɑ bu somi bɑ kɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Swɛ̃ɛ bɑnɑ. Bɑ ɡen kɑdiribɑ kuɑ kɑ ɡen kɔkɔrɔbɑ. Mɑ bɑ ye kpuro doke ɡɑmbo ye sɔɔ.

Ben bɔkuɔ Mɛremɔtu, Urin bii, Hɑkɔtun debubu, u mɑɑ somi sɔmbu te sɔɔ. Ben bɔkuɔ mɑɑ Mɛsulɑmu, Berekiɑn bii, Mɛsesɑbɛlin debubu u mɑɑ somi sɔmbu te sɔɔ. Ben bɔkuɔ, Sɑdɔku, Bɑɑnɑn bii u mɑɑ somi sɔmbu te sɔɔ.
Ben bɔkuɔ, Tekoɑɡibu bɑ mɑɑ nɑ bu kɑ somi sɔmbu te sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ ben wiruɡibɑ yinɑ bu sɔmbu ten kpɑrobu wiru kpĩiyɑ.
Yoyɑdɑ Pɑseɑkin bii kɑ Mɛsulɑmu Besodiɑn bii bɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Yesɑnɑ sɔnwɑ bɑ bɑnɑ. Bɑ ɡen kɑdiribɑ kuɑ kɑ ɡen kɔkɔrɔbɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ ɡen sɛ̃retii.
Be bɑ mɑɑ sɔmburu kuɑ ben bɔkuɔ be wee, Mɛlɑtiɑ Gɑbɑoniɡii kɑ Yɑdoni Mɛronɔtuɡii kɑ Gɑbɑoniɡibu kɑ Misipɑɡibu. Beyɑ bɑ bɑnɑ n kɑ ɡirɑri tem yɛ̃ron dirɔ wi Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u yi mi.
Ben bɔkuɔ be bɑ mɑɑ somi wee, Usiɛli, Hɑrɑyɑn bii wi u sɑ̃ɑ wurɑn sɔm kowobun turo kɑ Hɑnɑniɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ turɑre kowobun turo. Bɑ ben sɔmburu kuɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ sere mi Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑru tɑ yɑsum sosi.
Ben bɔkuɔ Refɑyɑ, Hurin bii wi u sɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmun bee tiɑn kpɑro u mɑɑ somi sɔmbu te sɔɔ.
Benin bɔkuɔ mɑɑ, Yedɑyɑ, Hɑrumɑfun bii u ɡbɑ̃rɑru sɔnwɑ u bɑnɑ te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ win yɛnun dee deeru. Yen biru Hɑtusi, Hɑsɑniɑn bii u bɑnɑ u swɛɛsi.
Mɑɑkiyɑ, Hɑrimun bii kɑ Hɑsubu, Pɑsɑti Mɔɑbun bii bɑ mɑɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten ɡɑm sɔnwɑ kɑ kɔ̃su yee te bɑ mɔ̀ Pɛ̃ɛn dɔ̃ɔ sɔ̃ru yeru.
Benin bɔkuɔ Sɑlumu, Hɑlosɛsin bii wi u Yerusɑlɛmun wɔɔ beri tiɑ kpɑre u mɑɑ somi kɑ win bii wɔndiɑbɑ.

Hɑnuni kɑ Sɑnɔɑɡibu bɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ wɔwɑ ɡiɑ sɔnwɑ bɑ ɡu bɑnɑ bɑ ɡen kɑdiribɑ kɑ ɡen kɔkɔrɔbɑ kɑ ɡen sɛ̃retii doke. Mi bɑ bɑnɑ mi, n kuɑwɑ ɡɔm soonu nɔrɔbu (1.000) bɑ kɑ ɡirɑri kɔnnɔ ɡèn min di bɑ rɑ kubɑnu yɑri.
Mɑɑkiyɑ Rekɑbun bii wi u sɑ̃ɑ Bɛti Hɑkerɛmun berɑn tem yɛ̃ro u kɔnnɔ ɡèn min di bɑ rɑ kubɑnu yɑri sɔnwɑ. Mɑ u ɡen kɑdiribɑ kuɑ u doke kɑ ɡen kɔkɔrɔbɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ ɡen sɛ̃retii.

Sɑluni, Kolohose Hoseen bii, Misipɑn tem yɛ̃ro u kɔnnɔ ɡèn mi ɡiɑ bwiɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔnwɑ u ɡen kɑdiribɑ kuɑ kɑ ɡen kɔkɔrɔbɑ kɑ ɡen sɛ̃retii. Yen biru u Siloen yɛrun ɡɑnɑ bɑnɑ u kɑ nɑ sere sinɑ bokon sɑɑdiɛ̃n ɡɑnɑn bɔkuɔ kɑ yɔɔtiɑ ye bɑ kuɑ bɑ rɑ kɑ de sinɑ boko Dɑfidin wuu ɡiɑ.
Win bɔkuɔ Nɛɛmi Asibukun bii, wi u Bɛti Surin bee tiɑ kpɑre u ɡbɑ̃rɑru sɔnwɑ u kɑ dɑ sere Dɑfidi kɑ wiɡibun siku yerɔ kɑ mi bɑ bwii ɡbɑ kɑ sere mi tɑbu durɔbun dirɑ wɑ̃ɑ.
Win bɔkuɔ Lefibɑn bweseru tɑ mɑɑ bɑnɑ sɑɑ min di. Wi u sɑ̃ɑ ben wiruɡii wiyɑ Rehumu, Bɑnin bii. Yen biru Hɑsɑbiɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Keilɑn bee tiɑn kpɑro u mɑɑ sɔnwɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ win berɑ ɡiɑ.
Ben bɔkuɔ win mɛro bisibu bɑ mɑɑ suɑ min di. Wi u bu kpɑre wiyɑ Bɑfɑi, Henɑdɑdin bii. Wiyɑ u mɑɑ Keilɑn berɑ ye yɑ tie kpɑre.
Ben bɔkuɔ Esɛɛ, Yosuen bii, Misipɑn sunɔ u mɑɑ suɑ min di u kɑ dɑ sere mi bɑ rɑ tɑbu yɑ̃nu bere ɡbɑ̃rɑrun ɡoo ɡɔmkirɔ.
Win bɔkuɔ Bɑruku, Sɑbɑin bii u mɑɑ suɑ min di u bɑnɑ sɑɑ ɡoo ɡɔmkii ten min di n kɑ ɡirɑri yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero Eliɑsibun dii kɔnnɔwɔ. U sɔmbu te kuɑ kɑ kĩru.
Sɑɑ min di, Mɛremɔtu, Urin bii, Hɑkɔtun debubuwɑ u mɑɑ bɑnɑ sɑɑ Eliɑsibun dirun kɔnnɔn di sere kɑ dii ten berɑ ɡiɔ.
Win bɔkuɔ yɑ̃ku kowo be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmun bɑru kpɑɑnɔ bɑ mɑɑ beɡiɑ bɑnɑ.
Ben bɔkuɔ Bɛnyɑmɛɛ kɑ Hɑsubu bɑ mɑɑ sɔnwɑ bɑ bɑnɑ ben diɑn dee deeru. Mɑ Asɑriɑ Mɑɑseyɑn bii, Anɑniɑn debubu u mɑɑ bɑnɑ win dirun bɔkuɔ.
Ben bɔkuɔ Binui, Henɑdɑdin bii u mɑɑ bɑnɑ sɑɑ Asɑriɑn dirun di sere kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten ɡoo ɡɔmkirɔ.
Pɑlɑ, Usɑin biiwɑ u mɑɑ sɔnwɑ ɡoo ɡɔmkii ten dee deerun di n kɑ dɑ wuu kɔ̃sobun dirɔ te tɑ sinɑ kpɑɑru mɛɛrɑ pirisɔm dirun bɔkuɔ. Min diyɑ Pedɑyɑ, Pɑreɔsin bii u mɑɑ sɔnwɑ.
Nɛtini be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡunɡunɔ bɑ mɑɑ sɔnwɑ bɑ bɑnɑ bɑ kɑ dɑ kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ nim ɡiɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ wuu kɔ̃sobun dirun dee deeru.
Ben bɔkuɔ Tekoɑɡibu bɑ mɑɑ sɔnwɑ bɑ bɑnɑ wuu kɔ̃sobun dii bɑkɑrun dee deerun di n kɑ dɑ ɡɑnɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡunɡurɔ.
Kɔnnɔ ɡèn min di dumi rɑ kɑ du, yɑ̃ku kowo ben bɑɑwurewɑ u mi sɔnwɑ u bɑnɑ win dirun dee deeru.
Ben bɔkuɔ Sɑdɔku, Imɛrin bii u sɔnwɑ u bɑnɑ win dirun dee deeru. Mɑ Semɑyɑ, Sekɑniɑn bii wi u sɑ̃ɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑn kɔ̃so u mɑɑ sɔnwɑ u bɑnɑ.
Win bɔkuɔ Hɑnɑniɑ, Selemiɑn bii kɑ Hɑnuni, Sɑlɑfun bii nɔɔbɑ tiɑse be, bɑ mɑɑ seewɑ bɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ ten ɡɑm sɔnwɑ. Mɑ Mɛsulɑmu, Berekiɑn bii u mɑɑ sɔnwɑ win dirun dee deeru.
Win bɔkuɔ Mɑɑkiyɑ wurɑn sɔm kowobun turo u mɑɑ sɔnwɑ u kɑ dɑ Nɛtinibɑ kɑ tenkubɑn yɛnusɔ Mifukɑdin kɔnnɔn dee deeru sere kɑ dii tɛɛrɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑrun ɡoo ɡɔmkirɔ.
Wurɑn sɔm kowo be, kɑ tenku be, bɑ mɑɑ sɔnwɑ dii tɛɛrɑ yen min di sere n kɑ dɑ kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Yɑ̃ɑnu.
Yibɛrɛbɑ
bɑ kĩ bu sɔmbu te yɔ̃rɑsiɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛ Sɑmbɑlɑ kɑ wiɡibu bɑ nuɑ mɑ bɛsɛ Yuubɑ sɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te bɑnimɔ, yerɑ bɑ mɔru seewɑ kɑ dɑm.

Mɑ bɑ sun yɑɑkoru mɔ̀ Sɑmɑrin tɑbu kowobun wuswɑɑɔ bɑ mɔ̀, mbɑ Yuu wɔnwɔndo beni bɑ mɔ̀. Sɑ ko bu deriwɑ bu ben sɔmbu te ko? Sɑ ko bu deriwɑ bu Gusunɔ ben Yinni yɑ̃kuru kuɑ? Sɑ ko wurɑ bu sɔmbu te wiru ɡo? Sɑ ko wurɑwɑ bu mɑɑ bɑn si seeyɑ sìn kpenu dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑkirɑ kpuro mi?
Tobiyɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑ Amɔni u wɑ̃ɑ win bɔkuɔ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, bɑnɑ yeren bweserɑ bɑ mɔ̀ mɛ. Gɑnɑ ye dɛmɑku ɡɑ̀ n yɔɔwɑ yɑ koo wɔrumɑ mi?

Yerɑ nɛ Nɛɛmi nɑ nɔɔɡiru suɑ nɑ nɛɛ, Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinni, ɑ swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ nɡe mɛ bɛsɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ sun yɑɑkoru mɔ̀. A de ben yɑɑko ten ɑre yi wɔri ben wiru wɔllɔ. A de bu ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ bu bu yoru mwɛɛri bu kɑ dɑ tem tukumɔ.
A ku bu ben durum wɔkɑ, domi bɑ sun wɔnwɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te sɑ bɑnimɔn sɔ̃.
Nɡe mɛyɑ sɑ kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te kpuro bɑnɑ sere ten ɡunum bɔnun sɑkɑ. Be bɑ sɔmbu te kuɑ, bɑ tu kuɑwɑ kɑ nuku tiɑ.
